Paper

Orientation

The browser's print dialog follows. To get a PDF, choose Save as PDF there; the paper size is already set. The map is printed as it is now: hidden groups stay hidden, group areas print if they are shown.
Earlier versions

Kept in this browser every five minutes in which something changed; the last 50.
Help
  • Click a node in the middle to rename it, near its edge to select it; its details are on the right.
  • Drag the blue handle of a selected node onto another to link them, or onto free space for a new linked node.
  • Double click a node: a new node of its group beside it. Double click the canvas: a new node there.
  • A click on a link sets its label, arrow and line; directions are seen from the selected node.
  • Keys: 0 fits the map, \ folds both columns, Delete removes the selection, Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes; Ctrl/Cmd+click selects several.
  • Text shows the map as lines; Apply takes an edit over.
